notes:
Account snapshot: enterprise MLOps org evaluating Redwood Dedicated for high-throughput, low-latency inference. Primary ask: predictable reserved GPU pool + model-specific tuning guidance.

Summary from 2026-02-24 call (CTO Alex R): "We cannot exceed 150ms p95 for live chat at 8k context; must support 32k for long-doc summarization." Wants hard SLOs and credit language in SLA.

Technical priorities:
- Models being evaluated: Llama-2-70B-chat (chat), Mistral-instruct-large, custom fine-tuned Llama-2-13B for internal reranking.
- Context goals: 8k baseline, 32k for monthly batch summarization jobs; need memory/kv-cache strategy per model.
- Quantization: prefer int8 / nf4 profiles for cost; ask Redwood guidance on AWQ/QLoRA compatibility on H100 vs A100.
- Batching strategy: dynamic batching w/ guaranteed max batch 16 (non-streamed); tight latency headroom for streaming (target p95 <= 150ms).
- KV cache: persistent per-user prefix caching, cross-request cache retention of 30s for chat sessions, benchmark on eviction policy.
- Throughput target: 800 qps peak for embeddings/reranking flows; 120 qps sustained for chat with average 128 token response length.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial reserved pool ask = 8xH100-80GB (primary) with documented burst to 16 GPUs; fallback plan using 12xA100-80GB if capacity constrained. Want cost vs perf comparison.

Compliance/ops asks:
- KMS integration for model keys, audit logs retained 13 months, SSO via SAML (Okta).
- Private control plane or VPC peering required for on-prem connector test.

Sales/contract notes:
- Procurement timeline: legal/infosec review window of 4-6 weeks. Requested SLA: 99.95% uptime + latency SLOs (p95 thresholds) + financial credits for breaches.
- Price sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit annual reserved in exchange for lower unit pricing and guaranteed throughput.

Stated quote from Head of Infra (Elena M): "If Redwood can demonstrate 150ms p95 at 8k on H100 with int8 quant and explain fallback to hosted, we can move to procurement fast."

Files referenced: drive deck with baseline benchmarks + config matrix (linked). Fireflies call id for 2/24 deep-dive (linked). Jira INFRA-4123 opened for A/B performance tests.

Internal AE notes: keep messaging focused on: capacity map (GPUs, expected qps), per-model tuning cookbook (context/quant/batching), and explicit SLA clause examples.

Short-term asks: 2-week dedicated POC (4xH100 min) w/ Redwood-run benchmarks, quantization playbook, and cost estimate for reserved 8x pool.
